_comment: FactoryForge tag id -> absolute address inside FF_IO for the snap7 driver, scene guarded-cell. Generated by tools/gen_starters.py from guarded_cell.scl's member order; DBX<byte>.<bit> for a Bool, DBD<byte> for a DInt or Real, as TIA's Offset column shows them.
_usage: factoryforge-sidecar connect --driver s7-snap7 -o host <cpu-ip> -o db <FF_IO's DB number> --mapping examples/tia/guarded-cell/snap7_mapping.json
_requires: FF_IO must NOT have optimized block access (the source sets S7_Optimized_Access := 'FALSE'); an optimized DB has no byte addresses at all. FF_IO is 22 bytes.
_layout: PLC-written members first, then simulator-written ones, each group with its DInts/Reals before its Bools, so no byte holds both directions (AGENTS.md gotcha 19d). Reorder the DB and these move.
_not_mapped_belt.rotate: belt.rotate is deliberately absent: starter.coil's contactor drives it; a program that writes it fails this exercise. The driver will report it as unmapped, which is correct.
